title: ruta chalepensis subsp. fumariifolia
intro: Ruta chalepensis subsp. fumariifolia, commonly known as Rock Rue, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ruta chalepensis subsp. fumariifolia include its ability to protect against cell damage, modulate the immune system, and exhibit wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
